doc: Service names, argument schemas (unit suffixes, AWR-03 §5.4), admission matrix and completion criteria (AWR-17 §7.1; AWR-12 §5.1-§5.4). The admission matrix is generated from state_model.admission_matrix() and equals AWR-12 §5.2 (BIZ-AC-002).

cause_cleared.doc: the cause of HOLD or automatic RTL has been cleared; energy RTL never (101, detail BATTERY)

frame.description: fw (D2, fixed wing and VTOL in FW mode): VelSetpoint16 vel[0] = commanded airspeed m/s, vel[1] ignored, vel[2] = climb rate m/s, yaw_rate = turn rate rad/s; Setpoint32 frame 2 (AWR-17 §17.7.6); 110 on multirotors

keepout_guard.description: server-side soft fence (D2): clamp removes the velocity component toward a keepout volume and warns KEEPOUT_CLAMPED; warn only emits uav.keepout_guard; off does nothing. Default: sandbox clamp, D1 off

notes: setpoints arrive only as WS CLIENT_DATA (awr.VelSetpoint16.v1); 250 ms watchdog ends the call with 209
